string-array.name: heart_messages
string-array.item: No ads. No tracking. No account. Just a launcher that pays its rent in coffee.
Nooko never asks for your data. It only asks, very politely, for a coffee.
Other launchers sell your attention. Nooko sells nothing, so it runs on coffee.
One coffee keeps the glass shelf polished and the bugs off your Home screen.
Nooko is made by one person and one very tired remote. A coffee helps both.
Your TV runs on electricity. Its home screen runs on coffee. Help keep it running.
Nooko will never show you an ad. It will show you a QR code, though. Fair trade?
A coffee a day keeps the cluttered home screen away.
Skipping the ads cost us our business model. A coffee fixes that.
If Nooko saved you one scroll through a crowded home screen, it earned a coffee.
